app.name: Kneedit
app.tagline: Keep up your knee exercises at home

safety.stopIfPain: Stop and contact your clinician if pain worsens.

disclaimer: Kneedit is not a medical device. It does not give medical advice or replace professional care.

errors.invalidCode: That code doesn't match anyone. Check it and try again.
errors.ownCode: That is your own code. Ask the other person for theirs.
errors.notFound: This was already answered or removed.
errors.notASenior: Only people who do the exercises can do this.
errors.demoMixing: Demo accounts can only connect to other demo accounts.
errors.confirmationMismatch: The word doesn't match. Type it exactly as shown.
errors.demoAccount: Demo accounts can't be deleted here.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired or is wrong. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.invalidEmail: Check the email address and try again.
errors.providerUnavailable: This way of signing in isn't set up yet. Use your email instead.
errors.noAccount: We couldn't find an account for that email.
errors.network: Kneedit can't reach the internet. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.nudgeRateLimited: You already sent a nudge today. You can send another tomorrow.
errors.demoOnly: This only works on demo accounts.

sampleData.label: Sample data: these numbers are made up for the demo.

plus.title: Kneedit Plus
plus.body: Plus gives family and the physiotherapist a fuller picture of how the exercises are going.

includes.notes: Notes from family for the physiotherapist
includes.visits: Visit bookings in the family calendar
includes.physio: Pain and ease answers and full visit summaries for the physiotherapist

plus.price: Kneedit Plus is SGD 15 a month. The Kneedit sleeve is SGD 29, paid once.
plus.unlocked: Every Plus feature is unlocked for now.
plus.nothingChanged: Nothing changed, because every Plus feature is already unlocked for now.
plus.started: Plus is on. Prototype, no payment taken.

welcome.title: Welcome to Kneedit
welcome.signInBody: New to Kneedit? Signing in also creates your account. We email you a code, so there is no password to remember.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Type it below, or tap the link in the email on this phone.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.

callback.tryCode: You can also sign in by typing the 6-digit code from the email.

senior.title: I do the exercises
senior.body: Follow the knee exercises your physiotherapist gave you.

caregiver.title: I help a family member
caregiver.body: See that the exercises got done, and cheer them on.

physio.title: I'm a physiotherapist
physio.body: See how your patients are doing between visits.

senior.title: About you
senior.body: This helps your family and physiotherapist know it's you.
senior.nameHint: Your family, friends and physiotherapist see this name.
senior.reminderHint: You can change this later in Profile.

nameHint.caregiver: Your family member sees this name when you ask to link.
nameHint.physio: Patients see this name when you ask to link.

linkCode.fieldHint: 6 letters and numbers, from their Kneedit Profile

scan.instructions: Point the camera at the QR code on their Kneedit Profile.
scan.cameraLabel: Camera, looking for a QR code
scan.permission: Kneedit needs the camera to scan the QR code. It takes no photos.
scan.permissionDenied: Camera access is off for Kneedit. You can type the code instead, or allow the camera in your phone's settings.

account.title: Account
account.deleteHint: Explains what is deleted before anything happens

pendingRequest.title: Waiting for approval
pendingRequest.sent: Request sent on {{date}}. You'll see their name once they approve it.
pendingRequest.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? You can send a new one later.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.demo: This is a demo account. The demo is reset with the seed script, so it can't be deleted here.
deleteAccount.permanent: Deleting your account is permanent. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.profile: Your name, email and sign-in are deleted, and you are signed out.

senior.title: Your exercises
senior.history: Your exercise history, answers, reports, visits and programme are deleted.
senior.links: Your links, friends and codes are deleted.
senior.loseAccess: These people lose access at once:

caregiver.title: Your family links
caregiver.links: Your links to family members end at once.
caregiver.notes: Notes you wrote stay on their record, shown as from a former caregiver.

physio.title: Your patients
physio.links: Your links to patients end at once.
physio.records: Programmes, visits and visit summaries you wrote stay on their record, shown as from a former physiotherapist.

reauth.title: Please sign in again
reauth.body: To keep your account safe, we need a fresh sign-in before deleting it. We'll email a code to {{email}}.

confirm.title: Are you sure?
confirm.body: To delete your account, type {{word}} below.

report.noSteps: No step counts this week. Steps need the sleeve.
